records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Product and license revenue decreased 23.8% to $444.4 million;

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Deferred revenues increased approximately $106.8 million as of December 31, 2020 compared to December 31, 2019 primarily due to an increase from subscription of $223.5 million, mostly from our cloud-based subscription offerings of $127.6 million and on-premise subscription license updates and maintenance of $125.3 million.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The net proceeds from this offering were approximately $738.1 million, after deducting the underwriting discount and estimated offering expenses payable by us.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Operating cash flows increased $152.7 million to $935.8 million.
